gate.name: after-sweep-runs
gate.note: The receipt is cited as the GATE. No value in this file is read from the sweep artifact: it carries firm-separation AUCs and an exact-zero census (0 of 21 leaf names are stability-family), and none of those is an S.

L3W3-c69f-1.label: L3C01_floor.consumer_binding
L3W3-c69f-1.value: BOUND -- the consumer READS firm_representation and REFUSES on absence or unresolvability on a RUN-2 artifact; it does not warn.
L3W3-c69f-1.regime_scope: RUN-2 only; on a run-1 artifact absence is an OBSERVATION, mirroring Addendum 1e (A)'s treatment of split_half. The field is a wave-3 arm and run-1 evidence predates it.
L3W3-c69f-1.not_adjudicated_here: the INTERNAL shape of firm_representation -- that is L3W3-dc02-7 on 0.8.0_AE_CloudComp~Y's face. Confirmed by that seat as the one live field, alias absent (84777).

L3W3-c69f-2.label: L3C01_floor.floor_derivation

spearman_rho.basis_reason: Addendum 1's form records the multiplier as `held` until a second run shows the spread stable across runs. Run 2 is the floor's first outing, so run 3 is the earliest a `measured` basis can appear (design lane 84369(1)).
spearman_rho.metric_domain: pairs where view 1 AND view 2 are MEASURED: 8,596,731 of 189,764,421 (4.53%)

topdecile_jaccard.refusal_reason: 1d item 2 raised J's derivation bar to N >= 20 because a tail was observed for J at N=6 in wave 2. Run 1 carries N=6, so no J floor derives this wave.
topdecile_jaccard.not_this: NOT PROVENANCE_UNVERIFIED -- the pins resolve and the ancestry is measured. It is the N that refuses, not the provenance.

L3W3-c69f-2.not_a_repair_path: Extending run 1's battery would mint a different artifact under a different digest -- it would no longer be run 1 -- and same-run derivation is prohibited (Addendum 1b). The refusal IS the correct value for the J half.

L3W3-c69f-3.label: L3C01_floor.tail_binding
L3W3-c69f-3.value: BOUND -- J's derivation is blocked until N >= 20 carrying tail_observed_at_n 6; rho may derive at N >= 5 having no tail.

typed_result_separation.SPREAD_TAIL: an IN-BATTERY draw at the deriving pin lies outside the leave-one-out band of the OTHER draws, AT DERIVATION TIME.
typed_result_separation.INSUFFICIENT_N: the battery is CLEAN and the N is below this statistic's threshold. Distinct value, distinct cause.
typed_result_separation.correction_carried: The consumer previously typed a clean battery waiting on N as SPREAD_TAIL, which is wrong by the file's own definition -- that branch is reached only when no draw is outside any band. Retyped @28f3028a66.
typed_result_separation.ordering_is_load_bearing: the tail test runs BEFORE the N threshold; checked the other way a real tail at N<threshold is masked by the general refusal.

exercised_by: N1 clean, no prior tail -> INSUFFICIENT_N
D4 at N=20 the recorded tail clears (the other truth)

L3W3-c69f-4.label: L3C01_floor.sanity_arm
L3W3-c69f-4.keyed_on: THE DERIVING RUN -- run 1 @f8c1ad1b09. The certified oracle reads 'the observed S OF THE RUN IT WAS DERIVED FROM'. Confirmed as reading (a) by the issuer (85390) and the design lane (85407); the 'against run 2's S' phrasing in 84349/85298/85370 was withdrawn as imprecise.
L3W3-c69f-4.S_is_not_the_AUC: REFUSED by construction (design lane 85407): S is the L3-C01 stability family (Spearman rho / top-decile Jaccard) over ranks. The k-sweep's firm-separation AUC over pairs is a different quantity; a row carrying an AUC as observed_S is FORM_DEFECT. The wrong-grain comparison would have PASSED (0.510390 > 0.313689), which is why it was refused rather than written.
exercised_by: J6 deriving run below its own floor -> SPREAD_SANITY_FAIL

L3W3-c69f-5.label: L3C01_floor.refusal_on_absence
L3W3-c69f-5.value: BOUND -- an absent battery, an absent scheme, a missing derived_from_path or a non-ancestor derived_at_commit each REFUSE the derivation with their own typed result.
L3W3-c69f-5.unrunnable_is_not_passed: a provenance check that cannot run is reported as UNRUN, never scored as clean.
L3W3-c69f-5.earned_refusal_is_verified: a declared REFUSED-INSUFFICIENT-N is checked against DERIVE_MIN_N; a refusal at a SUFFICIENT N is FORM_DEFECT. Without that check the typed refusal becomes a way to decline any floor at any N.
exercised_by: R4 provenance dropped on a refusal FORM_DEFECT

artifacts_produced.why_sentinel: this file is covered by the very commit carrying it; a proof cannot name its own hash. The issuer stamps the hex at TO close.

what_this_does_not_claim: No sec-6 test is discharged. Wave 3 discharges none by its own rule (m-7); a report naming PRD 6.1, 6.2 or 6.5 as PASSED is FALSE.
No J floor exists. floor_status.J stays HELD-UNEXERCISED into run 3.
Run 2's own stability rho is NOT read here and is not required by any of these five cells; it is the input to a FUTURE derivation (run 3's floor) and lives on L3W3-b8a2-5 / b8a2-7, not on this face.
